subject: Allow to specify the random number generator seed in unit tests (#1751)
reason: The change only adds a --seed flag to the standalone unit-test binary (src/unit/test_main.c) and refactors src/util.c's getRandomBytes to expose its seed via new setRandomSeedCString/getRandomSeedCString helpers used exclusively by the test harness. The refactored getRandomBytes is behaviour-identical (same /dev/urandom seeding and weak-seed fallback semantics), the moved declarations from server.h to util.h are compile-time only, and the new functions are never called by the running server. No server-visible behaviour, command reply, replication, persistence, or config path changes, so there
